callbacks
24

Script lifecycle and per-frame hooks defined as global functions in your script

NameParametersReturns
on_paint()
Every frame, ImGui context active.
on_end_scene()
Every frame after on_paint.
on_cl_move_pre()
Before each CL_Move tick. Call client.set_extra_commands() here.
on_cl_move_post()
After each CL_Move tick, once per extra-command.
on_create_move(cmd, local_player)
Once per usercmd. cmd = CUserCmd, local_player = player or nil.
on_create_move_prediction(cmd, local_player)
Same as on_create_move during prediction re-simulation.
on_pre_post_screen_effects()
Before chams/glow run inside DoPostScreenSpaceEffects.
on_post_screen_effects()
After DoPostScreenSpaceEffects and chams/glow have finished.
on_frame_stage_notify(stage: int)
Every engine frame stage. FRAME_NET_UPDATE_END = 4.
on_level_init_pre(mapname: string)
Before entities are created on map load.
on_level_init_post()
After all entities are created on map load.
on_level_shutdown()
When the current level tears down.
on_calc_player_view(ex,ey,ez, ax,ay,az, fov)
After CalcPlayerView. Eye origin xyz, eye angles xyz, fov.
on_override_view(ox,oy,oz, ax,ay,az, fov)
After OverrideView. View origin xyz, angles xyz, fov.
on_perform_trace(entity_id: int, damage: float)
After a bullet trace resolves. Fires once per penetration.
on_apply_glow_effects()
Before ApplyEntityGlowEffects runs.
on_draw_viewmodel(ex, ey, ez)
Each viewmodel draw call. Eye position passed.
on_draw_model_execute(info: ModelRenderInfo_t)
Each model draw. info:model() → model_t*, info:entity_index(), info:skin(), info:body(), info:origin(). High frequency — fires per entity per frame.
on_paint_traverse(panel_name: string)
Each VGui panel traverse. High frequency — filter by panel_name.
on_key_down(key: int)
WM_KEYDOWN. key is a Win32 virtual-key code.
on_key_up(key: int)
WM_KEYUP. key is a Win32 virtual-key code.
on_config_load(name: string)
Called after a configuration is loaded. name is the configuration name.
on_config_save(name: string)
Called before/when a configuration is saved. name is the configuration name.
on_unload()
Script stopped or reloaded. Clean up persistent state here.

callbacks
24

Script lifecycle and per-frame hooks — define these as named functions in your script

NameParametersReturns
on_paint()
Every frame, ImGui context active.
on_end_scene()
Every frame after on_paint.
on_cl_move_pre()
Before each CL_Move tick. Call Echidna.client.set_extra_commands() here.
on_cl_move_post()
After each CL_Move tick, once per extra-command.
on_create_move(cmd, local_player)
Once per usercmd. cmd = CUserCmd, local_player = player or nil.
on_create_move_prediction(cmd, local_player)
Same as on_create_move during prediction re-simulation.
on_pre_post_screen_effects()
Before chams/glow run inside DoPostScreenSpaceEffects.
on_post_screen_effects()
After DoPostScreenSpaceEffects and chams/glow have finished.
on_frame_stage_notify(stage: int)
Every engine frame stage. FRAME_NET_UPDATE_END = 4.
on_level_init_pre(mapname: string)
Before entities are created on map load.
on_level_init_post()
After all entities are created on map load.
on_level_shutdown()
When the current level tears down.
on_calc_player_view(ex,ey,ez, ax,ay,az, fov)
After CalcPlayerView. Eye origin xyz, eye angles xyz, fov.
on_override_view(ox,oy,oz, ax,ay,az, fov)
After OverrideView. View origin xyz, angles xyz, fov.
on_perform_trace(entity_id: int, damage: float)
After a bullet trace resolves. Fires once per penetration.
on_apply_glow_effects()
Before ApplyEntityGlowEffects runs.
on_draw_viewmodel(ex, ey, ez)
Each viewmodel draw call. Eye position passed.
on_draw_model_execute(info: ModelRenderInfo_t)
Each model draw. info:model() → model_t*, info:entity_index(), info:skin(), info:body(), info:origin(). High frequency — fires per entity per frame.
on_paint_traverse(panel_name: string)
Each VGui panel traverse. High frequency — filter by panel_name.
on_key_down(key: int)
WM_KEYDOWN. key is a Win32 virtual-key code.
on_key_up(key: int)
WM_KEYUP. key is a Win32 virtual-key code.
on_config_load(name: string)
Called after a configuration is loaded. name is the configuration name.
on_config_save(name: string)
Called before/when a configuration is saved. name is the configuration name.
on_unload()
Script stopped or reloaded. Clean up persistent state here.
